name: Web Scraping Script Pack

scripts.pattern: Walks ?page=N or Next-button pagination, saves table rows to CSV
Scrolls a feed to the end, dedupes, saves JSON
Logs in once, saves the session, reuses it on later runs
Diff-based product monitor, POSTs a Slack/Discord webhook on change
CSV rows in, one form submission per row, results report
Board/listing pages to JSON with cross-run dedupe
Expands sitemap indexes, honors robots.txt and crawl-delay, writes JSONL
sha256 change detection with archived previous shots
Polls a JSON endpoint, appends new records to JSONL
Exponential backoff, jitter, UA rotation, Retry-After aware

notes: Each file is self-contained with a how-to-run comment at the top and selector constants marked EDIT. Scripts 03 and 05 are for sites you own or have written permission to use.
